notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey Warlock's Tower players!

One quick announcement: last night we did a small update to the game, to fix some minor bugs which were affecting later stages. Stages Library B, 7 and Chambers A, 8 having been updated, as well as some of the logic concerning the jars and monsters behavior.

Things should be A-OK right now. And if they're not, please let us know! :)

Your faithful mailman,
Tim
http://i.giphy.com/l2JhI3GSgqw3aSqVW.gif
